$comment: CosmoMedic data model v1. camelCase, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps. Each top-level key is one local JSON file in data/mock/ (or one table/collection later). Values marked illustrative have no official NASA limit.

conventions.ids: string with prefix, e.g. ast-01, log-0001
conventions.missionDay: integer, Day 1 = mission start (no Sols: Sol is a Mars day)

fields.name: string
fields.commDelaySec: number · one-way delay to Earth (ISS≈1, Moon≈1.3, Mars up to 1200)

baseline.$comment: pre-flight exam, filled by the medical team, read-only in the app (onboarding just confirms)

avatar.name: string (default 'Bolt')
avatar.state: 'idle'|'walking'|'happy'|'tired'|'sleepy'|'sad' · one input of the animation state machine; Bolt's statuses are derived from this + logs (sleep, mood, injuries, meals, exercise) — see ANIMATIONS.md

logs.json.$comment: ALL health logs in one list. Overview screens filter by type; 'Logged today' = exists a log of that type with missionDay = today.

mood.label: 'great'|'good'|'okay'|'tired'|'stressed'
mood.tags: string[] e.g. calm, focused, homesick, lonely, anxious, overloaded

daily_summaries.json.$comment: Derived (computed on the fly in src/data/api.ts getDailySummary). Feeds the Status day scrubber, the hologram and the Home log menu. logsDone is recomputed from logs; areas include open injuries.

fields.logsDoneCount: 0..7 (mood, sleep, radiation, measurement, meal, exercise, injury not counted)
fields.areas: {head, torso, armL, armR, legL, legR}: 'ok'|'warn'|'alert' → hologram colors. Computed = stored areas, then every injury (logged up to that day) with status 'active' or 'healing' sets its area(s) to 'alert' (holoAlert). Mapping: head/neck → head, back → torso, arm/hand → armL/armR by side, leg/knee/foot → legL/legR by side ('center' → both). Left/right = the astronaut's side shown on the viewer's left/right column of the hologram (armL left, armR right).

fields.messages: AiMessage[] {id, astronautId, author:'astronaut'|'orbi', text, timestamp, mode:'journal'} · PRIVATE mode messages are never stored
fields.journal: JournalEntry[] {id, astronautId, timestamp, summary, moodLevel?, sourceMessageIds[]} · shown as 'Shared with Orbi' in Mood history
fields.alerts: Alert[] {id, astronautId, type:'poor_sleep'|'low_mood'|'bone_loss'|'fitness_drop'|'menu_fatigue'|'injury', level:'low'|'medium'|'high', text, evidence: string[] log/message ids, timestamp, sentToGround:boolean}

derived.leaderboard: rank astronauts by total logs (tab 'Daily logs') or avatar.coins (tab 'Coins')
derived.baselineDelta: (latest measurement value / baseline value − 1) × 100; alert thresholds: bone −1.5%/month, strength/aerobic −10% (NASA HRP averages)

fillWithOrbi.$comment: 'Fill with Orbi' (route /logs/orbi-fill). Not stored as its own file: it produces normal logs. Parser lives in src/data/orbiParser.ts behind an interface so it can be replaced by an LLM.
fillWithOrbi.categories: 'mood'|'sleep'|'radiation'|'body'|'meal'|'exercise' (body = blood pressure). Only categories with no log today are asked (FILL_ORDER).
fillWithOrbi.parserInterface: OrbiFillParser.parse(category, text, ctx) → { draft, understood: boolean, assumed: string[] (fields filled with defaults), skipped?: boolean }
fillWithOrbi.parseContext: { now:'HH:MM', lastBed?, lastWake?, restingBp?, restingHr?, lastDoseUsv? }

drafts.sleep: { bed:'HH:MM', wake:'HH:MM', quality: 1..5, wakeUps } → sleep log (durationMin = wake − bed)
drafts.radiation: { value, unit:'uSv'|'mSv', source, readAt:'HH:MM' } → radiation log
drafts.body: { systolic, diastolic, pulse } → measurement log (metric blood_pressure)
drafts.meal: { name, kcal, taste: 1..5, time:'HH:MM' } → meal log (macros estimated from kcal)
drafts.exercise: { modality, equipment, minutes, effort: 1..5 } → exercise log

fillWithOrbi.save: Confirm → addLog / saveDailyLog per draft (+10 coins each, logs get 'Logged today'); summary { saved: string[], coins } shown once on Home (session only).
